review_kind: AI static text review and primary documentation check, not human audit or vulnerability audit

primary_reference.title: Custom agents configuration
findings: Omitted tools defaults to all tools including configured MCP tools.
Supported aliases include read, search, edit and execute; web is not currently applicable to Copilot cloud.
An explicit tool allowlist selects tools but does not establish a filesystem or shell sandbox.

changes: Builder explicitly allows only read/search/edit/execute; publishing/signing/integration require separate mandate.
Release/recovery/performance explicitly allow only read/search and describe design/evidence review rather than execution.
Claims auditor cannot infer verified commit/tree/ancestry binding from a document's commit ID.
EU reviewer requires supplied primary sources; unverified online currentness and deadlines remain open.
Read-only red team supplies regression specifications, not executed tests or written artifacts.
Hardware profile requires bounded DMA and device/IPC length, offset, overflow and ownership validation.
Benchmark evidence includes all raw runs and failures, hashes with retained source/artifact identity, and a separate independent repetition before acceptance.
Release requires applicable source/dependency/reproducibility/SBOM/signature/signer/rollback receipts; missing evidence blocks acceptance.
Security disposition explicitly blocks broken invariants and treats absent proof as open.

validation.command:
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,re
from pathlib import Path
profiles=sorted(Path('.github/agents').glob('os-*.agent.md')); assert len(profiles)==16
for p in profiles:
 text=p.read_text(); assert text.startswith('---\n'); front,body=text[4:].split('\n---\n',1)
 fields={k:v.strip() for k,v in re.findall(r'^([\w-]+):\s*(.+)$',front,re.M)}
 assert fields['description'] and fields['target']=='github-copilot' and fields['disable-model-invocation']=='true'
 tools=json.loads(fields['tools'])
 assert tools==(['read','search','edit','execute'] if p.name=='os-builder.agent.md' else ['read','search'])
 assert len(body)<30000
print('PASS:16 profiles structurally valid within documented field subset; actual cloud runtime/tool confinement not tested')
PY
